fields.description: Issue includes local political commentary and reporting on the Miami Beach election and city politics, including discussion of councilmen and press coverage of H. Leslie Quigg. Features editorials on racetrack and dog track betting as a source of crime and juvenile delinquency, and a report on a Dade County tax-certificate sale described as a scandal involving coordinated bidding. Additional coverage includes a court case over the Tropicana Bar alleged to be a nuisance near Northwest Hospital, discussion of Florida Power & Light financing and municipal ownership debate, a proposal regarding milk price reduction, and assorted local news, columns, and entertainment/nightlife advertisements.
